digest.component_or_area: Plan Review caching and prompt structuring
propositions: Plan-bearing cache prefix must be byte-identical across Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts, single-sourced in prompts.py to prevent drift and enable provider-side prefix reuse.

Pass-1 finder system prompt begins with shared_plan_prefix(plan), containing full plan material; verifier templates replace {{plan}} in USER message with {{shared_prefix}} in system prompt, moving plan to stable cached segment.

Exhaustiveness directive (enumerate EVERY independent defect in THIS run) is added as a bullet of SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE and reaches every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF) and verifier prefix.
Verifier templates delete the volatile marker and trailing plan block; finding listing stays user-turn as base_instructions → instructions, never in system prompt.
Pass-1 warm gate condition changes from est_tokens(plan) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS to _prefix_tokens(plan) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS to measure actual cached bytes (preamble + plan).

plan_review_verify_inputs output schema removes plan property, adds shared_prefix; both plan-review.yaml verify steps wire shared_prefix from step outputs; plan-review-verifier removed from RELOCATED_PROMPTS.
